changelog:
videolink-to-article v1.0.0

- Initial release for extracting clean Markdown transcripts from Bilibili and YouTube video URLs using platform subtitles.
- Automates tool installation and registration (BBDown, yt-dlp) with persistent binary cache management.
- Supports comprehensive metadata extraction and structured output per video and task.
- Handles subtitle availability probing, authentication flows (browser cookies and manual cookies.txt), and proper selection of the highest-quality subtitle track.
- Outputs organized transcript files and metadata with clear directory conventions and deterministic-cleanup pipeline.
summary: Use when the user provides a Bilibili or YouTube URL and asks for a transcript, article, or subtitle extraction. Downloads platform subtitles via BBDown / yt...
